resources.string: The original action committed. Refresh the records before starting another action; do not repeat it.
Use an administrator-issued pairing code for the approved business wallet and receiving phone. Pairing does not credit a member.
This account is not approved for this phone. Contact admin.
Screen transitions only. Android controls keyboard and dialog animations.
Statement export cancelled. Open the member and try again.
The subscription number is Android metadata, not the MoMo phone number or proof of wallet ownership.
The displayed records have expired. Refresh before continuing.
Use a name of 2–100 characters without control characters.
No recorded events in this response
The operation was rejected by the authoritative service. Refresh the records before continuing.
Nothing has been submitted. Credentials will be cleared.
Receipt rejected; review the source without retrying a financial action.
Refresh the status and contact the administrator. Do not infer successful processing from a heartbeat or a network connection.
Records are hidden while the app is not active.
Receipt uploaded; this does not confirm a member credit.
Managed setup required. Contact your admin.
More records are available. Use Load more to continue.
Original SMS unavailable. Retry loading or go back.
New-message capture is paused. Previously retained receipts are not erased by pausing; review the queue before resuming.
Ask your administrator to reauthorize this installation. Retained receipts must keep their original source binding.
The previous action was rejected. Review the records before starting a different action.
Use an identification note of 8–500 characters without control characters.
A previous action is still pending. Check its authoritative result before doing anything else.
The retained-receipt count is unknown. Do not clear app data or reinstall to resolve this; contact the administrator.
Receipt upload is intentionally held. Local capture can continue if enabled, but queued receipts are not confirmed member credit.
Refresh the receiving-phone status. No capture, upload or member credit has been verified by this status check.
This record is unavailable. Go back or refresh.
The bound Android subscription is unavailable. Ask the administrator to verify the business SIM; do not relabel retained receipts.
Outcome not confirmed. Check before retrying.
Server sign-out is unconfirmed. Sign in again to check access.
Repeated receipt observation; no additional credit is implied.
Staff account unavailable. Go back and refresh the staff list.
Receipt delivery status is unavailable; no member credit is implied.
Member unavailable. Go back or refresh.
Local capture is enabled. A zero queue or recent upload does not by itself prove a new receipt or a member credit.
Use the Collect staff account approved for this phone.
Receipt delivery is separate from member credit.
The original action committed, but its financial effect changed. Review the current ledger; do not repeat the original action.
The original action committed, but its financial effect was reversed or corrected. Review the current ledger; do not repeat the original action.
Receipts remain in the local queue. Upload acknowledgement and canonical member credit are separate outcomes.
Saved history · may be out of date
Records stay hidden until your session and current records have been checked.
Refresh the receiving-phone status and follow the displayed recovery steps.
This account will no longer have access.
Phone replacement and SIM changes require the administrator\'s controlled procedure. Do not move the SIM, reset app data or discard the queue as a recovery shortcut.
Awaiting upload; not a confirmed member credit.
Only canonical payment and ledger records confirm member credit. Never add the local queue to displayed savings.
Contact admin for help completing Collect sign-in.
Still awaiting an authoritative outcome. Do not repeat this action; contact the administrator if it remains unresolved.
Passcode change not confirmed. Sign in again.
Received inconsistent records. Refresh or contact support.
Unable to sign in. Check your connection or contact admin.
An earlier action may have been submitted. Discarding this draft does not cancel it. Check the previous action before retrying.
Email or password could not be verified.
Contact your administrator to configure this phone.
Review the requested Android permissions. Grant access only on the approved receiving phone, then refresh this status.
Too many attempts. Try again later.
This build cannot pair or upload receipts. Use it only for the documented offline checks.
This history is too large for the phone. Contact an administrator for a full extract.
These records have expired. Reconnect and refresh before continuing.
Payment unavailable. Go back or refresh.
Only canonical transaction and ledger records are shown. A transaction record is not confirmation of member credit.
A previous action still needs confirmation. Refreshing or signing out does not cancel it.
Saved position could not be fully restored. Refresh when connected.
Saved position is beyond this list. Showing the nearest available position.
The previous action needs authenticated reconciliation. Do not repeat it; contact your administrator if the session changed.
Scroll amount to view all digits
Reopen this staff account from the refreshed list before saving. Your draft has not been submitted.
Unable to complete. Refresh and try again.
No eligible members. Change the search or ask an administrator.
Local recovery storage is unavailable. Do not repeat the action or clear app data; contact the administrator.
Recovery evidence is inconsistent. The action remains unresolved; contact the administrator.
The original action could not be verified for this account and phone. Do not repeat it or clear app data; contact the administrator.
The previous action needs an authenticated outcome check. Sign in with the same operator on this phone and check it. Do not repeat the action.
Action not accepted. Review the details.
Sign in again to check the original action. Do not submit it again.
An outcome check is already running. Do not repeat the financial action.
Outcome checks have stopped. Do not repeat the action or clear app data; contact the administrator.
The next outcome check is not due yet. The original action remains unresolved.
Recovery evidence changed or conflicts with the original action. Do not repeat the action or clear app data; contact the administrator.
